usedFor: CometChat holds chat users and groups, and Sangam CRM keeps them as leads through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in CometChat, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new chat user becomes a lead, and the action matches by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “New Message Received” in CometChat is polling and covers every message, so it can run often.
